questions.q: After how long does Betaflight consider the signal lost?
options: 150 ms without valid packets (100 ms in 4.5); the last values are held for 300 ms from the last good packet
questions.explain: 150 ms (100 ms in 4.5) — RXLOSS is set; the channels hold their last values for 300 ms from the last good packet, then take the rxfail values (Stage 1).
The setting is in tenths of a second.

questions.q: What does the DROP procedure do?
questions.explain: The motors stop; re-arming is possible after the signal returns, holds for failsafe_recovery_delay, and the arm switch is off.

questions.q: What does Betaflight do with ANGLE mode in Stage 2 (AUTO-LAND)?
options: Enables it itself if there is an accelerometer
Nothing: ANGLE is set only by the channel
Disables it so as not to interfere with the descent
Enables it only with a GPS fix
questions.explain: In Stage 2 the firmware enables ANGLE itself (fc/core.c) if there is an accelerometer; without an accelerometer there is nothing to level with — such an aircraft is better set to DROP.

questions.q: Which switch mode reproduces a link loss most honestly?
questions.explain: STAGE1 goes through both stages, as in a real signal loss.

questions.q: What is dangerous about KILL on a switch?
options: It triggers GPS Rescue instead of a disarm
A channel glitch is an immediate disarm
It does not work in flight
questions.explain: KILL disarms with no delay — any channel glitch drops the drone.

questions.q: How do you choose failsafe_throttle for AUTO-LAND?
options: Always 1500 — the middle of the throttle range
questions.explain: Slightly below the hover throttle from a log, aiming for a descent of about 1 m/s: a heavy 10" may need 1350, a light 7" — 1250.

options: Channel 5 is turned off for the duration of failsafe
questions.explain: a — auto, h — hold, s — set; for example, to enable ANGLE.

questions.q: What does GPS Rescue need in order to record home?
options: A fix with the required number of satellites
A working barometer and accelerometer calibration
questions.explain: A fix with ≥ gps_rescue_min_sats before arming. Without a home Rescue is useless; leave allow_arming_without_fix OFF.

questions.q: The aircraft does not arm. What does this status output mean?
questions.fragment:
# status
...
Arming disable flags: RXLOSS CLI
options: There are no valid RC frames, and the CLI is open — arming is blocked for both reasons
The accelerometer is not calibrated: the RXLOSS flag appears when there is no ACC calibration
The aircraft is tilted more than small_angle, which is encoded by the CLI flag
GPS Rescue mode is on without a satellite fix — that is what the RXLOSS and CLI flags mean
questions.explain: RXLOSS — no RC frames; CLI — while the CLI is open, arming is blocked deliberately.
